title: KR21 European e-Books & e-Lending Community of Practice – First Meeting
content:
When?

  • Date: 21 October 2026
  • Time: 11:00-12:30 CEST

    • What?

    Established by the KR21 programme, the Community of Practice provides a space to share experiences, exchange knowledge, and collaborate on practical solutions to the legal, market, and technological challenges affecting e-Books and e-Lending. Read more about the Community.

    The Community builds on the principles set out in Safeguard Access, Empower Europe: An Action Plan to Let Libraries Be Libraries, and supports collective action to remove barriers that prevent libraries from fully delivering their public interest mission in the digital environment.

    Save Your Spot!

    Register now to secure your spot.

    The Webinar

    This first meeting will focus on e-Lending systems. To set the stage, Chair Stephen Wyber will give a high-level overview of where e-Lending in Europe stands today. We will then hear from expert speakers who will share distinct perspectives on the legal framework, e-Book platforms, and the practicalities of managing e-Lending today.
